text: PR #5436 (#5427, migrate polyglot_supporting_artifact_admission.cpp) merged as ec1922b4c after 3 review rounds: round 1 found the migration needed the same post-read path re-walk fix #5426 needed (inline expected_sha256 check protects bytes-via-handle, not resolved_path_'s continued binding for a caller that doesn't revalidate); round 2 found the re-walk's denial reused containment_denied, conflating a TOCTOU-attack signal with the mundane initial-denial meaning -- fixed to use the existing artifact_changed value (already used by this file's own revalidate function) with a new changed_during_admission diagnostic, mirroring the sibling polyglot_artifact_admission.cpp's established convention; round 3 was judged unnecessary given the small, mechanical nature of round 2's fix. Added a new macro-gated COPPERFIN_ENABLE_POLYGLOT_SUPPORTING_ARTIFACT_ADMISSION_TEST_HOOKS test hook + regression test, verified to catch the regression and to be absent from a genuine -DCOPPERFIN_BUILD_TESTS=OFF production build via nm. Deferred issue #5438 (Windows containment-widening may reclassify an untested error code) rather than adding conditional probing logic. Issue #5427 closed. This closes out the #5409/#5420/#5421/#5426/#5427 atomic check-and-read migration series -- every genuine tight check-then-read pair found via the corrected #5422 survey is now migrated; #5434 (shared read-and-revalidate-path helper) and #5435/#5438 (error-code granularity follow-ups) remain as tracked, non-blocking cleanup. Also merged PR #5437 (migration-pipeline v1-blocking reclassification) earlier this session -- #137/#138/#139/#140/#141/#1076/#1077 are now live, eligible-for-selection v1 work per the earlier formal sync.
